summary: testHealthResolutionIsReusedByProductionFeatureEntryPoints exercises the real shared PiInvocationCache (not a stub): it resolves Pi via a temp fixture executable through the health check (refresh:true), then confirms defaultPiCommand/defaultModelListCommand/isolatedRPCCommand()  the only three production Pi-launch entry points in the codebase  return the identical executable/environmentPath from cache rather than independently re-resolving against the real process environment (which would diverge). This is a genuine counterexample-sensitive test: an entry point that bypassed the shared cache would fail the assertion.
